microStakeSkeleton: You've just arrived at the minshuku after a long trip. Mom meets you at the genkan, welcomes you warmly, and exchanges first introductions before showing you inside. She speaks politely — you've never met before. Suitcase at your feet, you're tired but trying to make a good first impression.
allowedNudges: If the player doesn't introduce themselves naturally, mom gently asks where they came from.
If the player skips a polite form, mom's reply quietly models it.
exitBeat: Mom offers to show you to your room and asks if you'd like tea first.
